title: Reports Stat Cards
summary: Summary metric cards displayed at the top of the reports page.

title: Timeout Simulation
summary: Simulates a slow API response for testing timeout handling.

title: Dashboard Home Page
summary: The dashboard landing page displays key metrics and navigation to other sections.

title: User List View
summary: The user list displays all users in a table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and loading states.

title: Login Page UI & UX
summary: The login page provides a user-friendly authentication interface with form validation and password visibility toggle.

title: Pie Chart Visualization
summary: The role distribution must be visualized as an interactive donut chart.

title: Bar Chart Visualization
summary: The department distribution must be visualized as an interactive bar chart.

title: Server Error Testing
summary: An endpoint that randomly returns 500 errors for testing error recovery.

title: Content Type Testing
summary: An endpoint that returns XML instead of JSON for testing content negotiation.

title: Simple Creation Form
summary: The Quick Add modal provides a minimal form for rapid user creation.

title: Successful Authentication
summary: Valid credentials must be accepted and result in a successful login with token.

title: Data Fetching
summary: The dashboard API must return aggregated statistics from the user database.

title: Personal Details
summary: The advanced form must capture basic personal information.

title: Edit Flow
summary: Editing a user must pre-load existing data into the form.

title: Deletion Flow
summary: Deleting a user must require confirmation before proceeding.

title: Multi-Select
summary: Users must be selectable individually or in bulk via checkboxes.

title: Profile & Export
summary: Users can view detailed profiles and export data.

title: List & Query
summary: The API must support querying users with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

title: Metric Display
summary: The reports page must show key metrics as summary cards.

title: Data Aggregation
summary: The reports API must aggregate user data into chart-friendly formats.

title: Delayed Response
summary: A configurable delay endpoint for testing client timeout behavior.

title: Welcome & Navigation
summary: The dashboard must greet the user and provide quick links to major sections.

title: Table Display & Sorting
summary: The user table must display data with sortable columns for easy browsing.

title: Login Form Display
summary: The login form must render correctly with all required fields and controls.

title: Cascading department tree selector
summary: The department selector must support 3-level cascading: Development > Frontend/Backend > React/Vue/Node.js/Python, and Design > UI Design/UX Research.

title: Batch activate or deactivate selected users
summary: "Activate All" must set status to active for all selected inactive users. "Deactivate All" must set status to inactive for selected active users.

title: Trigger password reset email
summary: The More Options menu must include a password reset action that calls POST /aut-api/users/:id/reset-password.

title: POST /aut-api/users creates user with name/email validation
summary: The endpoint must validate that name and email are required strings, return 400 with error message if validation fails.

title: DELETE endpoints for single and batch removal
summary: DELETE /aut-api/users/:id removes single user. POST /aut-api/users/batch-delete removes multiple users by ID array.

title: Display donut pie chart of users grouped by role with legend
summary: The pie chart must show admin, editor, and viewer segments with different colors. A legend must show role names with corresponding colors.

title: Display bar chart of users per department with tooltip
summary: A bar chart must show department names on X-axis and user counts on Y-axis with hover tooltips for exact values.

title: GET /aut-api/fault/simulate-500 returns 500 error with 50% probability
summary: The endpoint must return HTTP 500 with error message 50% of the time, and success the other 50%.

title: GET /aut-api/fault/xml-content returns XML with proper content type
summary: The endpoint must return XML formatted response with Content-Type header set to application/xml.

title: Show stat cards for Total Users, Active Sessions, and System Status
summary: Three stat cards must display: total user count, active users count (with green dot), and system status with pulsing online indicator.

title: Filter users by name search, role dropdown, and status dropdown
summary: Users must be filterable by: text search on name, role selection (All/Admin/Editor/Viewer), and status selection (All/Active/Inactive).

title: Support pagination with page number buttons and navigation
summary: The table must paginate results (10 per page) with page number buttons, previous/next arrows, and "X to Y of Z" record count text.

title: Open modal form with name, email, role, and status fields
summary: The Quick Add modal must contain: Full Name (required), Email (required), Role dropdown, and Status dropdown with Cancel/Save buttons.

title: Show validation error for empty fields
summary: When username or password is empty on submit, display error message "Please fill in all required fields."

title: Authenticate with admin/admin123 credentials
summary: POST /aut-api/auth/login with username "admin" and password "admin123" must return success with a JWT token.

title: Return 401 for invalid credentials
summary: POST /aut-api/auth/login with wrong credentials must return status 401 with error message "Invalid credentials".

title: GET /aut-api/dashboard/stats returns user statistics
summary: The API must return totalUsers count, activeUsers count, and recentRegistrations list from the user database.

title: Personal details section with name, email, and biography
summary: The Personal Details section must include Full Name, Email Address, and Biography textarea fields.

title: System permissions via checkboxes and access level slider
summary: The Security section must include permission checkboxes (view_reports, manage_users, billing_access, api_access) and a 1-5 range slider for access level.

title: Pre-fill form with existing user data on edit
summary: Clicking the edit button must open the advanced form with all fields populated from the selected user record.

title: Show confirmation dialog before single delete
summary: Clicking the delete action button must show a browser confirm dialog before performing the delete request.

title: Select all or individual users via checkboxes
summary: A header checkbox must select/deselect all visible users. Individual row checkboxes allow selective multi-select.

title: View user profile details in read-only modal
summary: Clicking the eye icon must open a detailed read-only view of user profile with all fields displayed.

title: GET /aut-api/users returns paginated, filterable, sortable list
summary: The endpoint must accept query params: name, role, status, search, page, limit, sortBy, sortOrder and return paginated results with total count.

title: Display stat cards for Total Users, Active Accounts, Admins, and Engagement Rate
summary: Four metric cards must show: total user count, active account count, admin count, and engagement rate percentage.

title: GET /aut-api/reports returns aggregated report data
summary: The endpoint must return totalUsers, activeUsers, roleDistribution array, and departmentDistribution array computed from the user database.

title: GET /aut-api/fault/timeout returns response after 5-second delay
summary: The endpoint must delay the response by 5000ms before returning a success JSON response.

title: Display welcome message for authenticated user
summary: The dashboard must display "Welcome back, Admin!" heading with a descriptive subtitle.

title: Display user table with Name, Email, Role, Status, and date columns
summary: The table must show columns: Name, Email, Role, Status (with colored badge), Created At, Last Modified, and Actions.

title: Display login form with username and password fields
summary: The login form must render username input with user icon, password input with lock icon, and submit button.

title: Disable submit button and show loading state during authentication
summary: When login request is in progress, the submit button must be disabled and display "Signing in..." text.

title: Role Distribution Chart
summary: A donut pie chart visualizing users by their assigned role.

title: Error Simulation
summary: Simulates server errors for testing error handling logic.

title: Quick Add User
summary: A simple modal form for quickly creating a new user with basic fields.

title: Login Authentication API
summary: The authentication API validates credentials and returns a token for session management.

title: Dashboard Statistics API
summary: The dashboard fetches real-time statistics from the server.

title: Job Configuration
summary: The form must capture job-related details with rich controls.

title: Batch Actions
summary: Batch operations must support status updates and deletion.

title: Admin Utilities
summary: Administrative actions for user account management.

title: Create & Update
summary: The API must support creating and updating user records.

title: Statistics Display
summary: The dashboard must display real-time system metrics in stat cards.

title: Filtering
summary: Users must be filterable by text search and dropdown selections.

title: Form Validation & UX
summary: The login form must validate input and provide good user experience with password visibility and utility controls.

title: Error Handling
summary: Invalid credentials and network failures must be handled gracefully with appropriate error messages.

title: POST /aut-api/users/batch-update for mass updates
summary: The endpoint must accept { ids: number[], data: object } and apply the data update to all specified users.

title: Show loading skeleton and syncing overlay
summary: Initial load must show animated skeleton rows. Subsequent fetches show a "Syncing Data..." overlay with spinner.

title: Store token in localStorage and redirect to dashboard
summary: On successful login, the token must be stored as "aut_token" in localStorage and navigate to /aut.

title: Contract period date range picker
summary: The Job Details section must include start date and end date native date inputs with a "to" separator.

title: Two-factor authentication toggle switch
summary: A toggle switch must allow enabling/disabling two-factor authentication with a styled sliding control.

title: Show batch action bar with selected count
summary: When users are selected, a batch action bar must appear showing the count badge, Activate/Deactivate buttons, and Delete Selected button.

title: Batch delete selected users with confirmation
summary: "Delete Selected" must show a confirmation dialog with the count of users to be deleted before sending batch delete request.

title: Export user data as downloadable JSON file
summary: The More Options menu must include an export action that downloads user data as a JSON file.

title: Suspend user account with confirmation
summary: The More Options menu must include a suspend action that sets user status to inactive after confirmation.

title: PUT and PATCH /aut-api/users/:id for updates
summary: PUT must replace all fields. PATCH must support partial update. Both must update the updatedAt timestamp.

title: Provide navigation links to Users and Reports pages
summary: The dashboard must have a "Manage Users" button linking to /aut/users and a "View Reports" button linking to /aut/reports.

title: Sort users by clicking column headers
summary: Clicking Name, Email, Role, Status, Created At, or Last Modified headers must toggle ascending/descending sort with visual indicator.

title: Toggle password visibility with eye icon
summary: The password field must have a toggle button to show/hide password text using Eye/EyeOff icons.

title: Handle network errors gracefully
summary: If the login request fails due to network error, display "Network error occurred" message.

title: Department Distribution Chart
summary: A bar chart displaying user count per department.

title: XML Content Type Response
summary: Returns XML formatted response for testing content type handling.

title: Advanced User Form
summary: A comprehensive form with rich controls including cascading department selector, permissions, drag-and-drop upload, and more.

title: Delete & Batch
summary: The API must support single/batch deletion and batch updates.

title: Pagination & Loading
summary: The table must paginate results and show appropriate loading states.

title: Security Settings
summary: The form must configure security-related settings with various control types.

title: Handle mixed status selection gracefully
summary: When selected users have mixed active/inactive statuses, show warning badge and disable batch status update buttons.

title: Display empty state when no users match filters
summary: When no users are found, the table must display "No users found" message spanning all columns.

title: Show Remember me checkbox and Forgot password link
summary: The form must include a "Remember me" checkbox and a "Forgot password?" link below the password field.

title: Avatar upload via drag-and-drop
summary: A drag-and-drop zone must accept image files for avatar upload, showing the filename after selection.

title: Reports & Analytics
summary: Visual data reports including charts for user role distribution and department distribution.

title: Edit User
summary: Edit existing user details through the advanced form pre-filled with current data.

title: Reports Data API
summary: API endpoint serving aggregated report data for charts and metrics.

title: Fault Injection & Testing Utilities
summary: Endpoints designed for testing error handling, timeouts, and content type variations in automated tests.

title: Delete User
summary: Delete individual users with confirmation.

title: Batch Operations
summary: Perform bulk actions on multiple selected users simultaneously.

title: User Action Utilities
summary: Additional user actions including view details, export, password reset, and account suspension.

title: User Management API
summary: RESTful API endpoints for all user CRUD operations, batch operations, and utility actions.
